entities.name: Query CYP1B1-like protein
observations: 553 aa sequence with an N-terminal hydrophobic segment consistent with a microsomal membrane anchor.
Contains a cytochrome P450 domain, Pfam PF00067.28, spanning residues 51–520.
Has 83.5% identity and 98.4% query coverage to reviewed human CYP1B1 UniProt Q16678; this strongly supports CYP1B1-like function.
Likely heme-thiolate monooxygenase using electrons from NADPH via cytochrome P450 reductase.
Likely involved in oxidation of endogenous lipids, steroid hormones, vitamins, and possibly xenobiotics; exact substrate specificity is not established from sequence alone.
Predicted primary localization is endoplasmic-reticulum membrane; mitochondrial targeting may occur for some CYP1B1 orthologs or conditions but is not established for this sequence.

entities.name: Human CYP1B1
observations: Reviewed UniProt Q16678; cytochrome P450 monooxygenase with heme cofactor.
Metabolizes endogenous substrates including fatty acids, steroid hormones, and vitamins; annotated activities include estrogen hydroxylation and arachidonic-acid epoxidation.
Primarily localized to the endoplasmic-reticulum membrane; mitochondrial localization is also reported under some conditions.

entities.name: Retinol metabolism
observations: CYP1B1 reference annotations associate CYP1B1-like proteins with oxidative retinol metabolism and retinoic-acid biosynthesis.

entities.name: Arachidonate metabolism
observations: CYP1B1 reference annotations associate CYP1B1-like proteins with arachidonic-acid epoxidation and lipid mediator production.

entities.name: Query protein properties
observations: Sequence-derived molecular weight is approximately 61.4 kDa; theoretical pI is approximately 7.17.
These values assume an unmodified monomer and do not account for processing, post-translational modifications, ligands, or oligomerization.
